title: When Does Trimming Help Conformal Prediction? A Retained-Law Diagnostic under Calibration Contamination
abstract: arXiv:2605.06204v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Trimming suspicious calibration points is a common response to contamination in conformal prediction. Its effect on clean-target coverage, however, is governed by the retained law induced by trimming, not by the contamination level alone. We analyse fixed-threshold trimming as conditioning rather than purification. It replaces the contaminated calibration law with a retained law, reducing clean-target coverage to a one-dimensional score-CDF transfer problem with an exact finite-sample identity. A componentwise bound on the transfer gap gives a population-level diagnostic. This separates a clean-side covariance cost from a retained-contamination cost, governed by the dirty-to-clean retention ratio. Trimming helps when the anomaly score separates retention probabilities while remaining score-neutral on the clean population. translated_title: 何时裁剪有助于保形预测？校准污染下的保留分布诊断
translated_abstract: 裁剪可疑的校准点是应对保形预测中污染问题的常见做法。然而，其对干净目标覆盖率的影响取决于裁剪所诱导的保留分布，而非仅仅取决于污染水平本身。我们将固定阈值裁剪分析为一种条件化操作而非净化操作：它用保留分布替换受污染的校准分布，从而将干净目标覆盖率问题简化为一个一维分数-累积分布函数（CDF）转移问题，并给出精确的有限样本恒等式。转移间隙的分量级界限提供了一个总体层面的诊断方法。该诊断将干净侧的协方差成本与保留污染成本分离开来，后者由脏到干净的保留比例所控制。当异常分数能够区分保留概率、同时在干净总体上保持分数中性时，裁剪才有帮助；否则，裁剪无法通过保留混合系数实质性地减少污染。我们还给出了……
tldr: 本文证明保形预测中裁剪操作对覆盖率的影响由裁剪后的保留分布决定而非污染水平，并给出裁剪有效的精确条件：异常分数需能区分保留概率同时在干净数据上保持分数中性。
en_tdlr: This paper shows that trimming's effect on coverage in conformal prediction is governed by the induced retained law rather than contamination level alone, and establishes an exact condition for when trimming helps: the anomaly score must separate retention probabilities while remaining score-neutral on the clean population.
